title_en: Fall 2026 Thesis Submission and Review Plan (Online Application: October 7–16)
summary: Master's and doctoral students who meet the thesis submission requirements and plan to graduate in February 2027 must apply online through mySNU between October 7 and October 16, 2026. They must submit the review registration documents to the department office (Building 301, Room 117) by October 20, 2026, and pay the thesis review fee between October 21 and November 3, 2026 (17:00). Integrated master's-doctoral program completers seeking a master's degree must submit a doctoral degree waiver form to Room 117 by September 29, 2026.
applies_to: Master's and doctoral students of the department who will undergo thesis review in Fall 2026 for graduation in the 2026 academic year first-half cohort (expected graduation February 24, 2027). To be eligible, students must: (1) have passed the thesis submission qualification examinations (foreign language and comprehensive/major examination); (2) have earned at least 24 credits (master's) or at least 60 cumulative credits (doctoral), including credits expected in Fall 2026; (3) be within the thesis submission deadline (4 years after course completion for master's, 6 years for doctoral); and (4) if they have completed coursework, be registered as graduate research students. Integrated master's-doctoral program completers who wish to obtain a master's degree must also give up the doctoral degree and submit a waiver form. Following the schedule is mandatory for those applying for review.

conditions: Only students who have passed the thesis submission qualification examinations (foreign language and comprehensive/major examination) may submit a thesis.
Master's students must have at least 24 credits and doctoral students at least 60 cumulative credits, including credits expected in Fall 2026.
Students whose thesis submission deadline has passed (4 years after completion for master's, 6 years for doctoral) are not eligible.
Students who have completed coursework must be registered as graduate research students.

Students who did not submit the preservation copy of their thesis last semester, and doctoral students whose review was deferred, will be entered in the online application in bulk by the university administration.
Students who cancel after paying the review fee must apply for a refund; however, the notice also states that paid review fees are not refundable.
No fee payment is accepted after the payment period ends.
Doctoral students whose review period extension was approved in Spring 2026 are exempt from the review fee and do not need to submit the registration documents.
The review fee is KRW 100,000 for master's and KRW 300,000 for doctoral students.
The advisor, emeritus professors and external members cannot be committee chair; the vice-chair is the advisor.
Master's students submit external committee member documents (allowance statement, personal details, personal information consent) only if applicable.
Doctoral committees must include at least one external member, and members must be listed as internal (chair, vice-chair, members) then external.
If a doctoral advisory committee member cannot be appointed to the review committee, a committee member replacement report must be submitted (doctoral advisory committee form, Form 2).

Doctoral students admitted in 2013 or earlier need at least one first-author paper published (or a certificate of acceptance) in an internationally recognised journal and the department head's permission before review (applies to those who completed coursework on or after March 1, 2000).

Doctoral students admitted in 2014 or later need at least two papers (one as main author, one as co-author) published (or certificates of acceptance) in internationally recognised journals and the department head's permission before review.
The doctoral preliminary review must be completed by the end of November; the preliminary and final reviews cannot both be held in December.
Theses must in principle be presented and written in English (department rule).
Integrated master's-doctoral program students are in principle awarded only the doctoral degree; a master's degree is an exception.
Integrated program completers may apply for a master's degree only after giving up the doctoral degree by submitting a waiver form to the department head.
An integrated program student who is awarded a master's degree can never receive the doctoral degree of that integrated program.

For integrated program completers seeking a master's degree, the thesis deadline is 4 years after completion, extendable by up to 2 years (those exceeding this may also be research students for 3 years).
Integrated program completers who passed the doctoral qualification examination may be exempted from the master's qualification examination.
A non-disclosure application must be submitted together with supporting documents (patent or business security documents).
For the final library submission, only the electronic file is submitted, with no printed copy; no submission or revision is possible after the deadline.
Students who do not submit the final thesis to the library cannot receive the degree.
steps: Integrated master's-doctoral program completers seeking a master's degree: Submit the doctoral degree waiver form (attached to the original notice) to the department office (Building 301, Room 117) by September 29, 2026.

All applicants: Read this notice and the attachments (Fall 2026 thesis review plan, registration forms, thesis writing guide, implementation guidelines, non-disclosure form, similarity-check guide, related forms); the attachment contents were not read for this translation.

All applicants: Between October 7 and October 16, 2026, apply online: log in to mySNU (student ID) → Student Services (학생서비스) → Graduation (졸업) → Thesis/Achievement Review Application/Cancellation (논문/실적심사 신청/취소).

All applicants: By October 20, 2026, submit the registration documents to the department office (Building 301, Room 117), using Attachment 2 (master's) or Attachment 3 (doctoral); doctoral students with a review extension approved in Spring 2026 skip this.

All applicants: Between October 21 and November 3, 2026 (17:00), print the fee notice via mySNU (student ID) → Graduation (졸업) → Thesis Related (논문관련) → "Thesis Review Fee Payment Notice" (논문심사료 납부고지서), then pay at the designated bank or by transfer to your personal virtual account (master's KRW 100,000, doctoral KRW 300,000).
All applicants: Submit your thesis for review directly to each committee member at least 7 days before your review.
All applicants: Submit the thesis review result report documents by December 29, 2026.
All applicants: If needed, submit the non-disclosure application form (attachment) with patent or business security documents by January 15, 2027.
All applicants: Submit the final approved thesis file online to the library between January 15 and February 1, 2027 (23:59); submission instructions will be announced separately.

Master's applicants: Include in the October 20 submission (Attachment 2): master's thesis review application, committee recommendation form (master's), research ethics compliance confirmation, and, if applicable, external member allowance statement, external member personal details and personal information consent form (external member).
Master's applicants: Submit the thesis for review according to the master's review schedule to be announced later; reviews are planned for early December.

Doctoral applicants: Include in the October 20 submission (Attachment 3): doctoral thesis review request, committee recommendation form (doctoral), external member allowance statement, external member personal details, research ethics compliance confirmation, personal details of the review candidate, international journal publication confirmation with a copy of the paper cover (including abstract), personal information consent form (external member), and, if needed, the committee member replacement report.

Doctoral applicants: Schedule and hold the preliminary review during November, and as soon as the date, time and place are fixed, email them to the department office for the public announcement (contact details are in the original notice).
Doctoral applicants: Hold the final review, including the public presentation, during December.
Doctoral applicants: If you need to extend the review period, submit the request by December 29, 2026.
translation:
Fall 2026 Thesis Submission and Review Plan (Online Application: 10/7 (Wed) – 10/16 (Fri))

We announce the master's and doctoral thesis review plan for Fall 2026. Students undergoing thesis review should refer to the information below and the attachments and prepare without errors in the schedule.

[Graduation year: 2026 academic year, first-half cohort (expected graduation 2027.2.24.)]

[Thesis submission eligibility]
1. Students who have passed the thesis submission qualification examinations (foreign language and comprehensive examination (major examination)).
2. Course credits
 - Master's: students who have earned 24 credits or more (including credits expected during Fall 2026)
 - Doctoral: students who have earned 60 or more cumulative credits (including credits expected during Fall 2026)
3. Students whose master's/doctoral thesis submission deadline (4 years for master's and 6 years for doctoral after course completion) has not passed.
4. Students who have completed coursework must be registered as graduate research students.

[Review application]
1. Online application by prospective thesis submitters
 a. Application period: 2026. 10. 7. (Wed) – 10. 16. (Fri) <10 days>
 b. Method: log in to mySNU (student ID) → Student Services (학생서비스) → Graduation (졸업) → Thesis/Achievement Review Application/Cancellation (논문/실적심사 신청/취소)
 ※ Students who did not submit the preservation copy of their thesis in the previous semester and doctoral students whose review was deferred will be entered in bulk by the university administration.
 ※ Those who cancel after paying the thesis review fee must apply for a refund.
2. Thesis review fee payment
 a. Payment period: 2026. 10. 21. (Wed) – 11. 3. (Tue) 17:00
 b. How to print the payment notice: log in to mySNU (student ID) → Graduation (졸업) → Thesis Related (논문관련) → select "Thesis Review Fee Payment Notice" (논문심사료 납부고지서) and print it.
 c. The prospective submitter pays directly at the designated bank or by transfer to their personal virtual account: master's KRW 100,000, doctoral KRW 300,000.
 d. Those approved for an extension of the doctoral thesis review period in Spring 2026 are exempt from payment.
 e. Paid review fees are not refundable; no additional payment is possible after the payment period ends.

[Submission of review application documents]
1. Deadline: by 2026. 10. 20. (Tue)
2. Place: submit to the staff member in charge at the department office (Building 301, Room 117).
3. Documents
 a. Master's documents: Attachment 2 "Master's Thesis Review Registration Form.hwp" (석사논문심사등록양식.hwp)
 (1) Master's thesis review application, 1 copy
 (2) Thesis review committee recommendation form (master's), 1 copy: the advisor, emeritus professors and external persons cannot be committee chair (the vice-chair is the advisor).
 (3) Research ethics compliance confirmation, 1 copy
 (4) External committee member allowance payment statement, 1 copy (only if applicable)
 (5) External committee member personal details, 1 copy (only if applicable)
 (6) Consent to collection and use of personal information (for external committee members / only if applicable)
 ※ The thesis for review is submitted later according to the master's thesis review schedule.
 b. Doctoral documents: Attachment 3 "Doctoral Thesis Review Registration Form.hwp" (박사논문심사등록양식.hwp)
 (1) Doctoral thesis review request, 1 copy
 (2) Thesis review committee recommendation form (doctoral), 1 copy
 - The advisor, emeritus professors and external persons cannot be committee chair (the vice-chair is the advisor).
 - List committee members as internal members (chair, vice-chair, members, in that order), followed by external members.
 - At least one external person must be included.
 - If a member of the thesis advisory committee cannot be appointed to the review committee, submit a committee member replacement report (attachment "Doctoral Thesis Advisory Committee Form / Form 2").
 (3) External committee member allowance payment statement, 1 copy
 (4) External committee member personal details, 1 copy
 (5) Research ethics compliance confirmation, 1 copy
 (6) Personal details of the doctoral thesis review candidate
 (7) International journal publication confirmation, 1 copy, and a copy of the paper cover (including abstract)
 ※ Department rules
 - Admitted in 2013 or earlier: a candidate for a doctoral degree in the Department of Aerospace Engineering must, in order to undergo thesis review, publish at least one paper (first author only) in an internationally recognised journal or submit a certificate of forthcoming publication, and obtain the permission of the department head. (Applies to students who completed the doctoral course on or after March 1, 2000.)
 - Admitted in 2014 or later: a candidate for a doctoral degree in the Department of Aerospace Engineering must, in order to undergo thesis review, publish at least two papers (one as main author, one as co-author) in internationally recognised journals or submit certificates of forthcoming publication, and obtain the permission of the department head.
 (8) Consent to collection and use of personal information (for external committee members)
 ※ The thesis for review must be submitted by each student directly to the committee members at least 7 days before the thesis review, according to the individual review schedule.
 ※ Doctoral students approved for a review period extension in the previous semester (Spring 2026) do not need to submit the registration documents.

[Thesis review schedule]
1. Master's: master's thesis reviews are planned for early December; the detailed schedule will be announced later.
2. Doctoral: doctoral thesis reviews are scheduled and held individually. In principle, the preliminary review is held during November and the final review, including the public presentation, during December. Details will be announced later.
 * As announced previously, the preliminary review must be completed by November at the latest. (The preliminary and final reviews cannot both be held within December.)
 * For doctoral students: as soon as the date, time and place of the preliminary review are fixed, please email them to the department office for the public announcement of the preliminary presentation (contact details are in the original notice).
※ Presentation and writing language: in principle, theses are presented and written in English (department rule).
※ Master's degrees for completers of the integrated master's-doctoral program (석박통합과정) (in effect from Fall 2016)
Under Article 89(3) of the University Regulations and the amended "Seoul National University Regulations on the Operation of the Integrated Master's-Doctoral Program" (2016. 9. 6.), completers of the integrated master's-doctoral program may obtain a master's degree if certain conditions are met.
① In principle, integrated master's-doctoral program students are awarded only the doctoral degree; a master's degree may be awarded as an exception.
② An integrated program completer who wishes to obtain a master's degree may apply only after giving up the doctoral degree of that integrated program, and must submit a doctoral degree waiver form to the head of their department.
③ If a master's degree is awarded in the integrated program, the doctoral degree of that integrated program can no longer be awarded.
④ When an integrated program completer applies for a master's degree, the thesis submission deadline is 4 years after completion, which may be extended (simple extension) by up to 2 years. (Those exceeding this may also be research students for 3 years.)
⑤ If an integrated program completer has passed the (doctoral) thesis submission qualification examination, the master's thesis submission qualification examination may be waived.
⑥ Applicants for master's thesis review in Fall 2026 must submit the doctoral degree waiver form (attachment) to the department office (Room 117) by 2026. 9. 29. (Tue).

* Reference schedule *
[Submission of thesis review result report documents] by 2026. 12. 29. (Tue)
[Application for non-disclosure of the thesis] by 2027. 1. 15. (Fri), submit the non-disclosure application form (attachment) together with the relevant documents (patent or business security documents).
[Request for extension of the thesis review period] by 2026. 12. 29. (Tue) (doctoral students only)
[Online submission of the final approved thesis to the library] 2027. 1. 15. (Fri) – 2. 1. (Mon) 23:59
 - Submit only the electronic file, without a printed copy.
 - No submission or revision after the deadline.
 - If you do not submit the thesis, you cannot receive the degree.
 - The submission method and student guidance materials will be announced separately.

◆ Inquiries: the department office (contact details are in the original notice).

1. Fall 2026 thesis review plan
